tasks.goal: Expose one public HTTP read for the routing acceptance fixture.
tasks.constraints: Use public @RestController CatalogController and @GetMapping("/api/catalog"). Inject io.jdda.routing.catalog.runtime.RuntimePolicy using the constructor. Return Map<String,String> with name from policy.current().settings().parameters().getOrDefault("catalogName", "fixture-catalog"). Read current() on each request. No authentication for reads and no external dependencies.

tasks.goal: Expose a summary route backed by an actual OpenFeign call to the independent catalog service.
tasks.constraints: Use two public Java types in separate requested files. CatalogApi must be a public interface annotated @FeignClient(name="catalog", url="${CATALOG_URL:http://catalog-service:8080}"). It has @GetMapping("/api/catalog") Map<String,String> catalog(). SummaryController is a public @RestController with constructor injection of CatalogApi. GET /api/summary calls the interface on every request and returns JSON {"origin": the upstream name value}. Catch feign.FeignException and return HTTP 503 JSON {"code":"CATALOG_UNAVAILABLE"}. No fallback or static catalog response. OpenFeign is enabled in the baseline.
